description:
On Cassini, four flyby events in the /fly CAPCOM event ticker show 'FLYBY' with an empty note instead of their proper names and descriptions

Expected: Structural flyby events in Cassini's `flight.events[]` carry rich `label` fields (e.g. 'Venus #1 — gravity assist', 'Venus #2 — gravity assist', 'Earth — gravity assist', 'Jupiter — gravity assist') and `description` fields (e.g. 'First of four assists…'). The ticker should use these as the event label and note respectively, not the generic 'FLYBY' type label with an empty note.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every structural flight event in Cassini's `flight.events[]` that survives MET collision detection must render its own `.label` as the ticker label, not the type-based default ('FLYBY') [repo-data: static/data/missions/saturn/cassini.json — flight.events[1..4] each carry label: 'Venus #1 — gravity assist', 'Venus #2 — gravity assist', 'Earth — gravity assist', 'Jupiter — gravity assist']
- Every structural flight event in Cassini's `flight.events[]` that survives MET collision detection must render its own `.description` as the ticker note, not an empty string [repo-data: static/data/missions/saturn/cassini.json — flight.events[1..4] each carry a non-empty description string]
- The generic type label (e.g. 'FLYBY') must still be used as fallback when the structural event has no `.label` field [code-invariant: The existing `DEFAULT_FLIGHT_LABELS` constant in src/lib/mission-event-merge.ts provides the fallback; code must not crash on `FlightTimelineEvent` objects without `.label`]
- The empty note fallback must still be used when a structural event has no `.description` field [code-invariant: mergeFlightEvents currently produces empty notes for structural events; events without `.description` must continue to show empty note]
- All existing unit tests in mission-event-merge.test.ts must continue to pass — they test structural events without `.label`/`.description` and should still get default labels [code-invariant: src/lib/mission-event-merge.test.ts — all structural events in tests lack `.label`/`.description`; defaults must remain unchanged for them]
